analysis.overall: You had a strong day with 84% time in range, anchored by rock-solid overnight stability and quick meal recoveries, despite a late-evening spike following dinner.

events.title: Smooth lunch baseline
events.description: Your 50g lunch bolus matched your meal nicely, keeping glucose steady between 88–110 mg/dL without any significant spike.

events.title: Late dinner spike
events.description: Glucose was already trending up when you ate dinner, causing a steep climb that peaked at 265 mg/dL late into the evening.

events.title: Overnight recovery
events.description: Correction doses gradually pulled your high evening numbers back down, setting you up for an extremely flat baseline around 90 mg/dL through the rest of the night.

events.title: Breakfast peak and quick return
events.description: Morning carbs bumped your blood sugar up to 169 mg/dL, but the bolus worked effectively to bring you back down to range within an hour.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for upward trends before dinner—eating while glucose is already rising makes late-night spikes much harder to prevent.
